info.title: Proton VPN API
info.description: One versioned API for the WebUI and scripts. Configure API_KEY separately from WEBUI_PASSWORD. Access is allowed with a valid bearer key, valid session cookie, or while WEBUI_PASSWORD is empty. An empty API_KEY disables bearer authentication, not open-mode access. Only valid bearer-authenticated writes bypass X-Requested-With. All POSTs require a JSON object (maximum 8192 bytes). Use HTTPS via a trusted reverse proxy outside a trusted local network. Errors use {"error": "message"}; no legacy error fields.

get.description: Current account, connection and forwarded port. Empty strings mean unavailable.
Null when unavailable. With format=text, returns a bare port number or an empty body.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Use text for shell scripts; otherwise JSON.

get.description: Last 15 minutes. Samples are [relative_seconds, received_bytes, sent_bytes]; newest sample is at 0 seconds. Totals are since connection, zero without samples.
Every setting with value, lock, source and kind. Choice settings include allowed choices; bool values use true or false. Environment values are read-only. No WebUI password or API key is exposed.

post.description: Validates and applies one setting. Environment-locked settings return 409; CLI rejection returns 422.
